description: Initialize zone variables. Values that can be set include extra, state, stress, stress-principal.
notes: '[zoneinitializeoptions]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (state, add, gradient, multiply, vary, stress).

keywords.name: state
keywords.description: The plasticity indicators for tetrahedrons are set to i . Normally the value of i used is 0 in order to reset the failure indicators.

syntax.7.0: stress [{xx <f> | xy <f> | xz <f> | yy <f> | yz <f> | zz <f>} ...]

description.7.0: Initialize the full stress tensor (xx yy zz xy xz yz). First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration. Options: xx <f>: xx -component of stress; xy <f>: xy -component of stress; xz <f>: xz -component of stress; yy <f>: yy -component of stress; yz <f>: yz -component of stress; zz <f>: zz -component of stress
description.9.0: Initialize the full stress tensor (xx yy zz xy xz yz). First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration.

syntax.7.0: stress-principal [{direction-intermediate <v> | direction-maximum <v> | direction-minimum <v> | intermediate <f> | maximum <f> | minimum <f>} ...]
syntax.9.0: stress-principal [{direction-intermediate <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | direction-maximum <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | direction-minimum <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | intermediate <f> [zoneinitializeoptions] | maximum <f> [zoneinitializeoptions] | minimum <f> [zoneinitializeoptions]} ...]

description.7.0: Initialize stresses via principal values and directions. First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration. Options: direction-intermediate <v>: Direction of intermediate principal stress.; direction-maximum <v>: Direction of maximum principal stress.; direction-minimum <v>: Direction of minimum principal stress.; intermediate <f>: Intermediate principal stress magnitude.; maximum <f>: Maximum (most postitive) principal stress.; minimum <f>: Minimum (most negative) principal stress.
description.9.0: Initialize stresses via principal values and directions. First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration. Options: direction-intermediate <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of intermediate principal stress.; direction-maximum <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of maximum principal stress.; direction-minimum <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of minimum principal stress.; intermediate <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Intermediate principal stress magnitude.; maximum <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Maximum (most postitive) principal stress.; minimum <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Minimum (most negative) principal stress.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Add the specified value to the existing value.

keywords.name: gradient
keywords.description: Apply a gradient to the scalar-value provided.

keywords.name: multiply
keywords.description: Multiply the existing value by the specified value.

keywords.name: vary
keywords.description: Apply a linear variation to the scalar-value provided.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: extra variable for array index i
